articles.title: HDFC Bank Logs 5% Rise in Profit on Margin Pressure
articles.content: HDFC Bank announced a notable five percent rise in profits for the June quarter, showcasing a robust growth in net interest income. Despite facing margin pressures that led to a contraction, the bank achieved a remarkable fifteen percent increase in gross advances, largely fueled by business and corporate loans. Additionally, deposits grew significantly, indicating strong customer engagement and successful operating efficiency strategies during the period.

articles.title: Cube Highways Trust InvIT, Indo MIM among 4 public issues opening this week
articles.content: Next week will witness the launch of four public offerings, including the Cube Highways Trust InvIT and three initial public offerings (IPOs). Notably, Indo MIM's IPO comprises both a fresh issue and an offer for sale, while Lohia Corp's venture consists solely of equity shares available in the offer for sale format. Additionally, Xtranet Technologies is set to introduce a Rs 170-crore fresh issue aimed at financing various initiatives.

articles.title: South Korea to expand use of won-denominated bonds for foreign investors
articles.content: South Korea has announced plans to enhance global acceptance of its currency by allowing foreign financial institutions to borrow won. Additionally, these institutions will be permitted to utilize won-denominated bonds as collateral. Furthermore, the dollar-won market trading hours have been expanded to twenty-four hours, seeking to integrate South Korea’s currency into the wider international markets.

articles.title: JK Cement Q1 profit drops 15.3% YoY to Rs 274.62 crore
articles.content: JK Cement Ltd reported a 15.3 percent decline in net profit for the June quarter.  The company posted Rs 274.62 crore profit, down from Rs 324.25 crore last year.  Revenue from operations increased by 20.25 percent to Rs 4,031.72 crore.  Total expenses rose by 25.5 percent during the same period.  JKCL's total income, including other income, grew 19.41 percent.
